title: Ex-Iranian hostage Barry Rosen warns regime 'will go down fighting' the US
description: The Iranian regime will "stick together like glue" and be nearly impossible to end, no matter whether the United States launches a military strike, according to a New Yorker who was tortured when held during the November 1979 Iran hostage crisis. Barry Rosen, 81, told The Post: "This regime will go down fighting. It has everything to lose.”
